title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `nimble_parsec`
description: mix.lock declares a locked package name in mix.lock within one edit of `nimble_parsec`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The lockfile records what Mix will fetch, so a name that only looks like the intended package is installed without any earlier review step. The name this rule expects is `nimble_parsec`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.lock (hex).
risk: The lockfile records what Mix will fetch, so a name that only looks like the intended package is installed without any earlier review step. The name this rule expects is `nimble_parsec`.
